A named starting search space for a tuning session. Files live in schema/search-spaces/&lt;name&gt;.v&lt;version&gt;.yaml and are embedded in bench (servtuner spaces); New session offers the ones that fit the managed target, and the space stays editable. A change is a new version.

Schema file: `schema/json/search-space-template.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `5730cfa50f08`.

## Top level

| Field         | Type                                             | Required | Description                                                                                   |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`        | `string`                                         | Yes      | Lower-case words joined by hyphens; the file name starts with it. pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$` |
| `version`     | `integer`                                        | Yes      | ≥ 1                                                                                           |
| `title`       | `string`                                         | Yes      | A short label for a picker. at most 80 characters                                             |
| `description` | `string`                                         | Yes      | When to start from it, and what it searches.                                                  |
| `fits`        | `object`                                         | Yes      | The managed targets it suits: their placement, and for Kubernetes their GPU count.            |
| `space`       | [search-space](/reference/schemas/search-space/) | Yes      |                                                                                               |
